laptops.summary: Built pause/resume on P and a persistent high score (localStorage with an in-session fallback) in separate worktrees via two subagents, and pushed ahmad/pause and ahmad/high-score. Merged both into main, resolving conflicts in game.js and settings.js, documented them in README.md and index.html, and pushed main 1c1b54d after Ahmad's manual test of the combined game. Later pulled the team main that Yazan had merged with Ruth's dark mode and Yazan's sounds and chaser drone; this laptop did not merge those.
laptops.notes: The merge session also wrote this report; its intervals stop at the report request. Turns started by the features session's own subagent notifications count as working. Only AskUserQuestion is counted as waiting: auto mode showed no manual permission prompts. Excluded logs: home-folder sessions (evil-binary-search) and the separate coin-dash folder, which are not this repository.
